rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_kpi_orthopedic(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	targetq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	targetq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	targetq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	targetq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	resultq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_kpi_orthopedic WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_kpi_orthopedic 
(
SELECT @id,n.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(10,11,12),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.PID),NULL)) targetq1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(10,11,12) AND n.an is not null,CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.PID),NULL)) resultq1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(1,2,3),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.PID),NULL)) targetq2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(1,2,3) AND n.an is not null,CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.PID),NULL)) resultq2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(4,5,6),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.PID),NULL)) targetq3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(4,5,6) AND n.an is not null,CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.PID),NULL)) resultq3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(7,8,9),CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.PID),NULL)) targetq4
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(n.DATE_SERV,'%m') IN(7,8,9) AND n.an is not null,CONCAT(n.HOSPCODE,'-',n.PID),NULL)) resultq4
FROM t_refer_sp5 n
INNER JOIN chospital h ON n.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.provcode in(@prov_c) AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12)
WHERE  n.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND clinic IN(5) 
AND SUBSTR(SP_CODE,1,5) IN('S4200','S6250','S6260','S9240','S9250','S5250','S5260','S5280')
AND n.splevel IN('M2','F1','F2','F3')
GROUP BY n.hospcode
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("targetq1"+"targetq2"+"targetq3"+"targetq4") as "target" ,SUM("resultq1"+"resultq2"+"resultq3"+"resultq4") as "result" ,SUM("targetq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("targetq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("targetq3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("targetq4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("resultq3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("resultq4") as "resultq4"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
